events.title: NOOSA alive! Festival 2026
events.location: Various iconic Noosa locations, Noosa Heads
events.description: A 10-day festival featuring an extraordinary lineup of literature, dance, and thought-provoking conversations by local, national, and international performers and speakers. Events are held across iconic Noosa locations, blending art and entertainment with natural beauty.

events.title: NOOSA alive! – Coping With Winter (Theatre Preview)
events.description: A preview performance of Australian playwright David Williamson's world premiere play, Coping with Winter, starring Erik Thomson. This theatrical event is a highlight of the NOOSA alive! festival.

events.title: NOOSA alive! – Coping With Winter (Main Performances)
events.description: The main performances of David Williamson's world premiere play, Coping with Winter, a headline theatrical event as part of the NOOSA alive! festival. It features Erik Thomson, Renai Caruso, and Janneke Williamson.

events.title: NOOSA alive! – Suzie Miller & David Williamson: Breakfast In Conversation
events.description: Join acclaimed playwrights Suzie Miller and David Williamson AO for breakfast and a conversation about writing, creativity, and contemporary theatre. This event offers insight into their craft and the current state of the arts.

events.title: NOOSA alive! – Bryan Brown: Canapés & Conversation
events.description: Australian acting icon Bryan Brown discusses his new thriller, The Hidden, over an exclusive afternoon of canapés and drinks. Guests will have a chance to meet him and get their books signed.

events.title: NOOSA alive! – Stars Alive! Showcase & Free Family Fun Day
events.location: River Stage, Lions Park, Gympie Terrace, Noosaville
events.description: A free community showcase featuring the Sunshine Coast's brightest young performers competing on the River Stage, alongside family-friendly entertainment. It's a relaxed outdoor event for locals.

events.title: Open Studios Sunshine Coast – Hinterland Trail Weekend
events.location: Hinterland studios (Glass House Mountains, Maleny, Montville, Mapleton)
events.description: A free, self-guided tour of over 70 artists' studios in the Sunshine Coast hinterland, offering a chance to explore diverse art forms and interact directly with creators. Visitors can purchase unique artworks and participate in hands-on workshops.

events.title: Advanced ChatGPT – for Noosa Seniors
events.description: A hands-on technology workshop designed for seniors to delve deeper into AI tools like ChatGPT, fostering digital literacy and community connection in the Noosa area. Expect practical exercises and guidance.

events.title: Embodied Flow – Somatic Dance and Intentional Movement
events.datetime: This week (check Eventbrite for exact date/time)
events.description: A somatic movement workshop combining dance, body awareness, and intentional movement practices for embodied exploration and community connection. It focuses on authentic wellness rather than commercial spirituality.

events.title: East Coast Breathwork Tour – Sunshine Coast
events.datetime: This week (check Eventbrite for exact date)
events.description: A grounded breathwork session designed for connection and release, part of a national tour. It offers an authentic, community-oriented wellness experience on the Sunshine Coast.

events.title: NOOSA alive! – KOAL (Interactive Solo Theatre)
events.description: An intimate and experimental interactive solo physical theatre show performed by Jacinta Yelland, presented as part of the NOOSA alive! festival. Perfect for those seeking unconventional and immersive performances.
